title: Concatenating round spans
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine with states in $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$, and let $a$ be an action for that machine. Suppose configurations $d,e,f$ of the associated $(k+2)$-tape round machine satisfy the following: the run from $d$ reaches $e$ after $T$ steps, and at every earlier time its state is present and is neither the entry state nor the halt state, while its input-head position and each of its first $k$ work-tape head positions agree with either the corresponding position in $c$ or the position after applying $a$ to $c$; and the run from $e$ reaches $f$ after $U$ steps with those same intermediate-time conditions. Then the run from $d$ reaches $f$ after $T+U$ steps and satisfies those conditions at every time strictly before $T+U$.
